_comment: Live-tunable properties of the sprite-sheet skins, and the source of truth
for them. Written by the sidebar on /qa/skins (Save), read by
client/src/skin/sprite.rs at compile time via include_str!.
Only properties that can change without rebuilding the art belong here.
Rotation and repeat length are baked into the PNG by
client/design/tools/sprite_sheet.py and are not tunable at runtime.
